items.whatsMissing: Compensation covers only cloudhook failure; a store failure after trigger+cloudhook creation leaves a live orphaned trigger with no owning link.
items.action: Extend creation compensation to remove the trigger and cloudhook on any failure after they exist.

items.whatsMissing: An exhausted-but-still-active link (allowance edited down, or claim raced) is audited but never retired and its trigger never removed.
items.action: When the claim finds the allowance spent on an active link, retire it (status used) and remove its trigger.

items.whatsMissing: Unreachable for real triggers: the home-side window guard suppresses the tracking event, so out-of-window attempts are never audited.
items.action: The trigger always reports the attempt; the window gates only what the home would run — refusals stay auditable.

items.whatsMissing: Same as E2.S2.A4 — not-yet-valid attempts never reach the add-on to be audited.
items.action: Same mechanism as E2.S2.A4.

items.whatsMissing: A failed trigger removal after a successful use reports the use as an error to the recipient, and the removal is never retried.
items.action: Report the use by its own outcome; audit the removal failure distinctly; retry removal via the sweep (E1.S4.A5).

items.whatsMissing: Sending is not guarded by link status — an SMS can be sent for an expired/used/revoked link whose trigger URL is already dead.
items.action: Refuse (or warn on) sending for non-active links.

items.whatsMissing: No reconciliation exists: trigger events fired while the listener is disconnected are silently lost — no count, no audit, no retirement.
items.action: On (re)connect, compare each active link's home-side trigger last-fired time against the last processed use; claim and audit missed uses (never execute actions late) and retire exhausted links.

items.whatsMissing: When no POST/confirm-page path exists the add-on silently issues a preview-bot-consumable GET link.
items.action: Warn (or fail closed) before sharing a bot-consumable link.

items.whatsMissing: After the atomic claim, the tracked entity writes a stale absolute UsageCount back over the row on the next save, re-opening the lost update.
items.action: Never mutate UsageCount on the tracked entity; rely on the atomic claim and re-read the count for display/decisions.

items.whatsMissing: The tuned connection string (busy timeout, pooling) is dead in production: run.sh exports ConnectionStrings__DefaultConnection which always wins.
items.action: Make production use the tuned settings (fold them into run.sh or stop overriding).

items.whatsMissing: The shared-page host runs JS with the fragment in scope and could exfiltrate every hook; not surfaced as full trust.
items.action: State the trust plainly in UI/docs; recommend first-party/self-hosted.

items.whatsMissing: Any HA service/template can be smuggled into a link's actions.
items.action: Allowlist permitted action domains/services.

items.whatsMissing: The add-on uses a full-admin token for everything.
items.action: Use least-privilege / supervisor-scoped access (see E9.S8).
Add a recipient success confirmation.

items.whatsMissing: A refused link (expired/used/revoked) gives the recipient no meaningful message.
items.action: Add recipient-facing refusal explanations.

items.whatsMissing: No operator notification when a link is used.
items.action: Emit an HA notification on success, toggleable.
Optional notification on out-of-grant attempts.

items.whatsMissing: No localisation; HA add-ons are expected to be multilingual.
items.action: Externalise strings; add HA add-on translations.

items.whatsMissing: If ingress is bypassed the dashboard is fully unauthenticated.
items.action: Defence-in-depth auth / shared-secret independent of ingress.

items.whatsMissing: Spoofable forwarded IPs poison the audit trail; X-Ingress-Path unvalidated.
items.action: Validate ingress path; don't trust forwarded IPs for audit.

items.whatsMissing: A half-open connection wedges the listener forever with no signal.
items.action: Add heartbeat/receive timeout → forced reconnect.

items.whatsMissing: Token expiry/revocation loops silently forever.
items.action: Surface a distinct actionable state; back off.

items.whatsMissing: A transient messaging-provider outage at boot takes the whole add-on down.
items.action: Degrade SMS only; start with a warning.

items.whatsMissing: A failed migration crash-loops with no backup and no rollback path.
items.action: Pre-migration backup + clear failure handling.

items.whatsMissing: A wedged-but-live process is never restarted by the home.
items.action: Add /health (DB + listener liveness) + watchdog in config.yaml.

items.whatsMissing: Nothing runs tests, the facit gate, or a multi-arch build on change.
items.action: Add CI: dotnet test + facit validate + per-arch build.

items.whatsMissing: Dead supervisor-token path; operator forced to hand-create a full-admin token; dual config mechanisms.
items.action: Use SUPERVISOR_TOKEN + scoped API by default; manual override only; one config path.

items.whatsMissing: No recurring schedule — only one contiguous window.
items.action: Model day-of-week + daily time windows; guard executes within an occurrence.
Per-occurrence allowance.

items.whatsMissing: One link = one recipient number.
items.action: Multi-recipient / group send with per-recipient delivery records.

items.whatsMissing: No scannable code for a link.
items.action: Render a QR for the share URL.

items.whatsMissing: Links list is unbounded, status-only, no search.
items.action: Add search/filter (name/recipient/date) + paging.

items.whatsMissing: Older audit events are unreachable in the UI.
items.action: Paging/filtering/date range over full history.
Export link + audit history (CSV/JSON).

items.whatsMissing: Every link is attributed to 'WebUI'; the authenticated user is discarded.
items.action: Attribute to the ingress-authenticated household member.

items.whatsMissing: Silent timezone assumptions can shift the whole window if container TZ != operator TZ.
items.action: Make the intended timezone explicit and consistent form→storage→guard→display.

items.whatsMissing: Creation validates parse-only; execution enforces a stricter contract, so an accepted link can be unexecutable and still burn a use.
items.action: Validate and normalize actions at creation to the execution contract (accept the home’s service-call syntax).

items.whatsMissing: No retry exists for failed trigger removals; a dead link’s trigger can stand indefinitely.
items.action: Sweep retries removal for dead links whose trigger still stands.

items.whatsMissing: The picker silently discards an unparseable hand-edited draft.
items.action: Preserve the draft and tell the operator when a picker addition cannot parse it.

items.whatsMissing: Nothing re-arms pre-upgrade or stale-mode triggers; legacy automations still embed real actions and run them on every fetch.
items.action: On startup, re-arm every active link’s trigger to the current model, window, and sharing mode; audit each re-arm.

items.whatsMissing: Share URLs are derived from current config while the trigger’s accepted method is frozen at arm time — they can disagree (405).
items.action: Derive the share URL from the armed trigger’s mode (with startup re-arm keeping them aligned).
